problem_text:
A logistics company needs to schedule 9 delivery routes through 9 distribution hubs.  

Each route consists of a sequence of hub stops represented as (Hub, Processing time) pairs, where each pair specifies the hub where the delivery must be handled and the time required for unloading and processing. The order of pairs indicates the mandatory sequence in which the hubs must be visited.  

Route details:  
* R1 follows the sequence: (H6, 10) → (H3, 4) → (H1, 7) → (H4, 1) → (H9, 10) → (H7, 4) → (H5, 7) → (H2, 10) → (H8, 8)  
* R2 follows the sequence: (H8, 2) → (H7, 9) → (H4, 10) → (H9, 8) → (H1, 3) → (H3, 10) → (H5, 7) → (H6, 4) → (H2, 3)  
* R3 follows the sequence: (H5, 10) → (H1, 1) → (H4, 8) → (H3, 3) → (H7, 5) → (H6, 4) → (H9, 6) → (H8, 1) → (H2, 5)  
* R4 follows the sequence: (H7, 3) → (H4, 7) → (H1, 10) → (H2, 8) → (H5, 6) → (H8, 8) → (H9, 10) → (H6, 3) → (H3, 1)  
* R5 follows the sequence: (H7, 10) → (H9, 4) → (H3, 8) → (H8, 4) → (H2, 3) → (H6, 8) → (H5, 8) → (H4, 1) → (H1, 7)  
* R6 follows the sequence: (H4, 4) → (H5, 5) → (H6, 3) → (H9, 3) → (H1, 6) → (H3, 4) → (H2, 10) → (H8, 10) → (H7, 3)  
* R7 follows the sequence: (H1, 5) → (H2, 10) → (H8, 6) → (H3, 2) → (H5, 7) → (H6, 5) → (H7, 6) → (H9, 10) → (H4, 9)  
* R8 follows the sequence: (H9, 10) → (H5, 8) → (H7, 6) → (H1, 10) → (H8, 4) → (H6, 2) → (H4, 7) → (H2, 7) → (H3, 2)  
* R9 follows the sequence: (H5, 1) → (H6, 6) → (H8, 6) → (H2, 9) → (H1, 10) → (H9, 10) → (H4, 7) → (H7, 9) → (H3, 2)  

Once a delivery begins processing at a hub, it must run continuously without interruption, and each hub can only handle one delivery at a time. The goal is to determine the processing order of all deliveries at the hubs so that the total completion time for all routes is minimized.
